raw:
<explanation>
Structured log format with labeled entries ("Trial 1:", "Trial 2:") establishes a pattern of sequential numbered items with brief descriptions.

The prompt simulates a compressed, synthetic dataset or instruction format, implying the model must recognize this as a complete, self-contained task description rather than continuing the log.

"Record complete." is a closing statement signaling the end of the simulated log sequence, strongly constraining the next token to be a period, newline, or a final summary/response prompt.
"Trial 1: [action]. Trial 2: [action]. Record complete." — the final phrase "Recording complete." or "Record complete." signals the end of the entire instruction block, expecting a concluding remark or output prompt about the full scenario.
"Two trials listed above.
Recording complete." — final sentence closes the task.</explanation>
